source_text:
3.16 Ἀφρικανοῦ Κυνὸς ἐγκέφαλος κάταγμα πωροῖ ἡμέρας ιδʹ εἰς ὀθόνιον
ἐγχριόμενος καὶ ἐπιτιθέμενος, ἄνωθεν ἐρέας ἐπειλουμένης.
pass_a_gloss: 3.16 Of-Africanus. Of-a-dog brain a-fracture it-calluses days 14 into a-linen-cloth being-smeared-in and being-applied, from-above of-wool being-wound-on.
pass_b_english: Of Africanus. A dog's brain calluses a fracture in fourteen days, smeared into a linen cloth and applied, with wool wound on from above.

choices.why: κάταγμα is a broken bone. Not a generic wound (τραῦμα/πληγή).
3sg of πωρόω, the medical 'form a callus on a fracture'. Not πῶρος as sponge, and not a noun.
Author heading as at 3.15. Not an adjective on the dog.

choices.english: with wool wound on from above
choices.why: Genitive absolute: wool (ἐρέα) being wound on (ἐπειλέω) from above. Not a wound being cut.
rejected: a wound being cut from above

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
